q: Which club won the first La Liga title, played in 1929?
sub: Real Madrid, then called Madrid FC, finished second.

q: Which Seville club won its only La Liga title in 1934-35?
sub: Madrid finished second, three points behind.

q: Which club finished second in La Liga in both 1993-94 and 1994-95?
sub: Barcelona pipped them the first year, Real Madrid the second.

q: Which Basque club won back-to-back La Liga titles in 1980-81 and 1981-82?
sub: Real Madrid were second in the first of the two.

q: Which Canary Islands club finished second in the 1968-69 La Liga?
sub: Real Madrid took the title that year.

q: Which Brazilian striker won the Pichichi with 30 goals for Barcelona in 1993-94?
sub: He was gone to Flamengo within eighteen months.

q: Which Dutch striker won the Pichichi with Deportivo La Coruña in 2002-03?
sub: Twenty-nine goals, and Bayern Munich bought him that summer.

q: Which Uruguayan won the Pichichi with Villarreal in 2004-05?
sub: He won it again with Atlético Madrid in 2008-09.

q: Which Girona striker won the Pichichi in 2023-24?
sub: Twenty-four goals, in the season Girona finished third.

q: Which goalkeeper won the Zamora trophy four seasons in a row from 2015-16?
sub: The Zamora goes to the keeper with the lowest goals-to-games ratio.

q: Real Madrid and Barcelona are two of the three clubs never relegated from La Liga. Which is the third?
sub: All three are founder members from 1929.

q: Whose Spanish league goalscoring record did Barcelona's Lionel Messi pass in 2014?
sub: Zarra's 251 goals for Athletic Bilbao had stood since 1955.

q: Which English club did Sevilla beat 4-0 in the 2006 UEFA Cup final?
sub: It was Sevilla's first European trophy.

q: Which English club did Atlético Madrid beat 2-1 in the 2010 Europa League final?
sub: Diego Forlán scored twice, the winner in the 116th minute.

q: Which French club did Valencia beat 2-0 in the 2004 UEFA Cup final?
sub: Valencia won the league and the UEFA Cup that season.

q: Who scored the only goal of the 1998 Champions League final for Real Madrid?
sub: It ended a 32-year wait for a seventh European Cup.

q: Which club beat Real Madrid 3-2 after extra time in the 2004 Copa del Rey final?
sub: Their fifth Copa del Rey, and their last.

q: Which club beat Recreativo Huelva 3-0 in the 2003 Copa del Rey final?
sub: It was the island club's first Copa del Rey.

q: Which club did Sevilla beat 1-0 in the 2007 Copa del Rey final?
sub: Sevilla won the UEFA Cup the same month.

q: Which club did Real Sociedad beat 1-0 in the 2020 Copa del Rey final?
sub: The Basque final was held back a year and played with no crowd.

q: Which manager replaced Rafael Benítez at Real Madrid in January 2016?
sub: He won the Champions League five months later.

q: Which manager did Barcelona sack in January 2020, with Quique Setién taking over?
sub: He had won La Liga in both of his full seasons there.

q: Which Serbian led Atlético Madrid to the league and cup double in 1995-96?
sub: He later managed both Real Madrid and Barcelona too.

q: Which Argentine took Valencia to the Champions League finals of 2000 and 2001?
sub: He lost both, to Real Madrid and then Bayern Munich.

q: Which manager won the UEFA Cup with Sevilla in both 2006 and 2007?
sub: He left for Tottenham Hotspur a few months after the second.

q: Which Dutch club did Barcelona sign Ronaldo from in 1996?
sub: He scored 34 league goals and left for Inter Milan after one season.

q: Which club did Luis Enrique leave on a free transfer to join Barcelona in 1996?
sub: He ran his contract down and then stayed eight years at Barcelona.

q: Which club did Real Madrid sign Claude Makélélé from in 2000?
sub: Real Madrid sold him on to Chelsea three years later.

q: Which striker moved to Inter Milan in the 2009 deal that took Zlatan Ibrahimović to Barcelona?
sub: He won the treble with Inter Milan the following season.

q: Which club did Villarreal sign Juan Román Riquelme from in 2003?
sub: He went on loan first, then signed permanently.

q: Which Dane won four straight La Liga titles with Barcelona and then a fifth with Real Madrid?
sub: The fifth came in 1994-95, the season after he crossed.

q: Which club plays its home games at El Sadar?
sub: The ground in Pamplona is named after the river Sadar.

q: Which club plays at El Molinón, the oldest ground in Spanish professional football?
sub: In use since at least 1908, on the site of an old watermill.

q: Which club was relegated in 2011-12, one season after finishing fourth in La Liga?
sub: A final day defeat to Atlético Madrid sent them down.

q: Which Madrid club was relegated in 1999-2000 in the same season it reached the Copa del Rey final?
sub: Espanyol beat them 2-1 in the final at the Mestalla.
